title: Dereth Town Tour - Fiun Outpost scratch

shots.standingOrder: Hover 22 m above the sea 110 m north of the outpost and tilt from straight down on the water up to the towers and the ice wall; barely drift.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING + WATER (drone.tilt-reveal). Over open sea (100 % water, z 24) 110 m NNE of the outpost: starts looking -80 deg down into the dark Arctic water and floe, then tilts up to -6 deg revealing the frozen shore, the Life Stone sparkling at the ice edge, the two Sho towers with chimney smoke and the 100 m ice wall behind, drifting 10 m toward it. Nearest scenery 41 m. shots.standingOrder: Crane up from 1.5 m to 8.5 m while swinging 35 degrees round the trainers' brazier, ending looking down into the ring of Fiun; stay 4 m outside the ring.
shots.notes: FLAME FX (classic.crane). Starts 9 m NNE of the smouldering brazier at eye height with the ring of flames and the six Fiun augmentation trainers around it, the ice wall behind; the arm rises 7 m and swings 35 deg, ending above the ring looking down on the fire glow on snow. 8 m from the snow rock. shots.standingOrder: Start hidden behind the east tower 15 m beyond it, then truck 15 m to the right until the Life Stone and open sea appear; keep 6 m from the tower.
shots.notes: PARTICLE FX + WATER (classic.reveal-from-occluder). Camera 62 m SSE of the Life Stone at z 7.7 (4.4-5.7 m above the ice) with the east Sho tower filling the frame; it holds, then trucks ~15 m to the right until the Life Stone's sparkle column stands clear on the sea ice with the open sea behind (line of sight clear from t ~5 s). shots.standingOrder: Fly east at 6 m/s 7 m above the open ice and roll one full turn at mid-shot; nothing within 15 m.
shots.notes: FPV FLOURISH (fpv.fpv-flip over open ground). 60 m pass along y ~47455 from x 10885 to 10945, 6.4-8.6 m above the frozen flats, one 3 s barrel roll at mid-shot: ice crystals, the sea on the left and the Silyun portal hut ahead spin through the frame. shots.standingOrder: Push from 34 m in to 5 m from the Portal to Silyun at eye height, keeping the swirl centred; never closer than 4 m.
shots.notes: PORTAL FX / TRANSITION (classic.push-in, perceptual). From WNW of the portal (bearing 300) the camera glides from 34 m to 4.8 m at 2-4 m height until the swirling portal fills the frame - the cut to Silyun, its destination. Suggest a dissolve or fadewhite into the next town.
